title: 第二百八十三章 魔音引蛛第二百八十二章 绝境逢生
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
月色西沉，林间溪畔的湿气渐重。
大约两小时后，张三率先从那场生死逃亡所引发极度的疲惫中苏醒过来。
意识回笼的瞬间，张三首先感觉到的是怀中温软而真实的触感，以及鼻尖萦绕的一缕无比清晰且浓郁的冷香。
这个香味，自己好像颇为熟悉，只是从未如此清晰的闻过。
而这个香味的主人是——
张三猛地睁开眼，低头看去，发现一位冷艳美人正被他紧紧搂在怀中，她的头枕在他的臂弯里，面纱早已在之前的混乱中脱落，露出了那张清冷绝艳却此刻显得异常柔和的容颜。
此时美人双眸紧闭，气若幽兰，似乎仍在沉睡。
张三顿时大惊失色，冷汗“唰”地一下就冒了出来。
朱华音？！她咋在我怀里？
他脑海里瞬间闪过朱华音平日那冰冷如霜的脸庞以及她动辄呵斥甚至动手的严厉模样。
尤其想起当初在浴池的误会以及之后她看自己时那恨不得杀之后快的眼神……这要是被她醒来发现此刻情景，自己怕不是要被她的白银玄凤笛戳成筛子？
张三吓得浑身僵硬，连呼吸都屏住了，生怕惊醒了怀中的“寒冰火山”。
然而，朱华音并未醒来。或许是因为魂力耗尽又经历了生死逃亡，她陷入了深度睡眠，全身柔若无骨，平日里紧绷的神经此刻难得地放松下来。
张三不敢乱动，保持着这个姿势，心跳如擂鼓。
在近距离之下，张三才惊觉，这位平日里总以黑衣裹身、气质冷冽拒人千里的罗刹教音使，身材竟出乎意料地……有料。
即便隔着衣物，他也能感受到那紧贴着自己的娇躯曲线玲珑，该丰腴处丰腴，该纤细处纤细，绝非外表看上去那般清瘦。
在张三认识的女人中，似乎也只有柳二龙那火爆傲人的身材，能在这种“实质感受”上压她一头了……
这个念头刚冒出来，张三就恨不得给自己一巴掌。
都什么时候了，还想这些乱七八糟的！
他连忙眼观鼻鼻观心，试图驱散脑海中不合时宜的遐想。

就在他心猿意马、努力克制之时，怀中的朱华音睫毛忽然颤动了一下。
张三心头一紧，暗道不好。
果然下一秒，朱华音缓缓睁开了眼睛。
初醒的迷茫只持续了短短一瞬，当她看清自己正被张三以极其亲密的姿势抱在怀中，而张三的脸近在咫尺时，那双清冷的眸子瞬间瞪大，瞳孔收缩，一抹羞愤至极的红晕迅速从脸颊蔓延至耳根。
“你……！”
朱华音本能地想要挣脱，但身体依旧虚弱无力，这一动反而更像是在张三怀里蹭了一下。
“朱前辈！冷静！听我解释！”张三吓得魂飞魄散，连忙松开手臂，像被烫到一样向后挪了挪，同时语速飞快地说道，“事急从权！绝对的事急从权！当时您昏迷了，血瞳鬼蛛王和蜘蛛群马上就要追到，我只能用川海归元带您土遁逃走！为了亲……不是，为了给您维持呼吸，才……才不得已冒犯了！但我发誓，除了救命的必要接触，我绝对没有做任何逾越之举！天地可鉴啊！”
content_en:
The moonlight is sinking in the west, and the humidity on the forest stream is getting heavier.
About two hours later, Zhang San was the first to wake up from the extreme exhaustion caused by that life-and-death escape.
The moment his consciousness returned, the first thing Zhang San felt was the soft and real touch in his arms, as well as an extremely clear and rich cold fragrance lingering on the tip of his nose.
This scent seemed quite familiar to me, but I had never smelled it so clearly before.
And the owner of this fragrance is——
Zhang San opened his eyes suddenly, looked down, and found a cold and charming beauty being held tightly in his arms. Her head was resting in his arms. The veil had already fallen off in the previous chaos, revealing that cold and beautiful face that looked extremely soft at the moment.
At this time, the beauty's eyes were closed tightly, her breath was like orchid, and she seemed to be still sleeping.
Zhang San was shocked and suddenly broke out in cold sweat.
Zhu Huayin? ! Why is she in my arms?
Zhu Huayin's usually frosty face flashed through his mind, as well as her stern appearance of scolding and even attacking at every turn.
Especially when he thought of the misunderstanding in the bathtub and the look in her eyes that wanted to kill her when she looked at him afterwards... If she woke up and found this scene, wouldn't she be stabbed into a sieve by her silver black phoenix flute?
Zhang San was so scared that he was so scared that he even held his breath for fear of waking up the "ice volcano" in his arms.
However, Zhu Huayin did not wake up. Perhaps because her soul power was exhausted and she had experienced life and death, she fell into a deep sleep, her whole body was as soft as a bone, and her normally tense nerves were rarely relaxed at this moment.
Zhang San didn't dare to move, and kept this posture, his heart beating like a drum.
At close range, Zhang Sancai was shocked to realize that this Rakshasa messenger, who usually wore black clothes and had a cold temperament that made people aloof from thousands of miles away, had an unexpectedly... good figure.
Even through the clothes, he could feel that the delicate body that clung to him was curvy, plump where it should be, slender where it should be, and definitely not as thin as it looked on the outside.
Among the women Zhang San knows, it seems that only Liu Erlong's hot and proud figure can surpass her in this "substantial feeling"...
As soon as this idea came up, Zhang San wanted to slap himself.
How long has it been, and I’m still thinking about all this nonsense!
He quickly looked at his eyes, nose, and heart, trying to dispel the inappropriate thoughts in his mind.
Just when he was distracted and trying to restrain himself, Zhu Huayin's eyelashes in his arms suddenly trembled.
Zhang San felt nervous and secretly thought it was not good.
Sure enough, the next second, Zhu Huayin slowly opened his eyes.
The confusion when she first woke up only lasted for a short moment. When she saw that she was being held in Zhang San's arms in an extremely intimate manner, and Zhang San's face was very close, her cold eyes widened instantly, her pupils shrank, and a blush of embarrassment quickly spread from her cheeks to her ears.
"You...!"
Zhu Huayin instinctively wanted to break away, but her body was still weak. This movement was more like rubbing against Zhang San's arms.
"Senior Zhu! Calm down! Listen to my explanation!" Zhang San was so frightened that he quickly let go of his arm and moved back as if he had been burned. At the same time, he said quickly, "Submit to authority in emergencies! Absolutely follow authority in emergencies! You were unconscious at the time, the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King and the Spider Horses We are going to catch you, so I can only use Chuanhai Guiyuan to take you to escape! I have to offend you for my own sake...not to keep you breathing! But I swear, apart from the necessary contact to save my life, I will never do anything beyond that!"
